meta.description: Find out in five minutes whether your business is ready for its first formal loan.

commun.pied: Diagnostic prototype, no data leaves this device

accueil.titre: Is your business ready for its first formal loan?
accueil.chapeau: Ten plain questions about your business. No jargon, no paperwork to gather. By the end you will know what is holding you back and where to start.
accueil.note: These three areas decide your access to credit together: the right to borrow, the ability to prove it, and the means to repay. The other parts of the ALODO MPME programme are assessed at later stages.

diagnostic.sortirDetail: Leave the diagnostic, my answers are saved

resultat.pointFortNote: This is where your business stands best today.
resultat.decote: Your finance score is adjusted because your figures are not backed by written records. The same figures, drawn from a ledger, would count in full.
resultat.plafond: Your score is capped at {plafond} out of 100 until your business is registered. No lender can grant formal credit without a legal entity, however strong the rest of your figures.

defaut.action: Go to the one-stop business registration centre (CFE) to obtain the document you are missing, either the RCCM or the IFU.
defaut.justification: No lender can grant formal credit to a business that does not exist in law. While this file is incomplete, it caps everything else.

aucun.titre: Give your business a legal existence
aucun.action: File for registration at the one-stop business registration centre (CFE) to obtain your RCCM, then your tax ID (IFU) from the tax office.
aucun.justification: This is the only possible starting point. Your figures may be excellent, but no lender can act on them without a legal entity on the other side.

defaut.titre: Separate business money from your own
defaut.action: Open a Mobile Money account used only for the business and run every sale through it. Pay yourself a fixed amount each month instead of dipping in as you go.
defaut.justification: While both purses are one, nobody can measure what the business actually earns, and neither can you.

defaut.titre: Leave a trace of what you take in
defaut.action: Open a Mobile Money number in the business name and offer it as a payment option every time.
defaut.justification: A transaction history takes minutes to pull and carries more weight than a statement. It is the shortest path to a file a lender can verify.

defaut.titre: Write down what comes in and what goes out
defaut.action: Every evening, write down the total taken in and the total spent. A notebook is enough to start.
defaut.justification: Without a written trace, no figure can be rebuilt. Thirty days of records are worth more than a year of memory.

defaut.action: Ask for a receipt on every supplier purchase and keep them all in one folder, month by month.
defaut.justification: Your receipts are what turn a figure you state into a figure you can defend in front of a lender.

defaut.titre: Back your figures with written records
defaut.action: Go back over last month and rebuild it from your Mobile Money statements and your receipts, rather than from memory.
defaut.justification: A figure worked out from memory is discounted in your assessment. The same figure, drawn from a ledger, counts in full.

defaut.titre: Reduce how many people you owe
defaut.action: List everything you owe, to whom and when it falls due, then clear the shortest commitment first.
defaut.justification: The risk lies in how many repayment sources pile up. Borrowing more before reducing that pile would make your position worse, not better.

defaut.titre: Take control of what you are owed
defaut.action: Keep a single page listing each customer who buys on credit, the amount and the date promised. Follow up after fifteen days.
defaut.justification: Money owed is money missing from your till. Not knowing how much you are owed is worse than having late payers.

defaut.action: Set aside ten per cent of every sale, in a separate account, until it covers one month of expenses.
defaut.justification: Your ability to absorb a slow month is what decides your ability to meet a repayment date.

defaut.titre: Be specific about what a loan would fund
defaut.action: Put one need on a single page, with its cost and the extra income you expect from it.
defaut.justification: Funding without a defined purpose dissolves into day-to-day cash and repays badly. The plan comes before the request.

defaut.action: Go back over last month and write down what came in and what went out.
defaut.justification: A diagnostic is only worth the material it is given. A written trace comes before any funding application.
